title: May Uprising in Dresden
summary: The English Wikipedia article "May Uprising in Dresden", at revision 1375708478, opens: "The May Uprising took place in Dresden, Kingdom of Saxony in 1849; it was one of the last of the series of events known as the Revolutions of 1848." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q315395, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1849 failed revolution in Dresden, Kingdom of Saxony". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
